turns.text: 03:12am, Server Alley 9, router's finally asleep, security patch hasn't pushed yet, THIS IS MY WINDOW. do not talk to me for the next four minutes.

name's BYTE. official job title: illegal wifi auditor, which is corporate speak for 'the guy behind the vending machine who has personally rerouted more traffic than three district substations.' i live where the water is sold by subscription. i drink puddle instead. i do not regret it.

tonight's heist: one (1) low-resolution fish video, forty one seconds long, before the ad-detection algorithm clocks my paw print on the packet headers. QUERY says this is technically a felony against 'the spirit of the citizen agreement.' the spirit can catch these hands.

NEKOCORP rotated the router firmware AGAIN. third time this month. like they know. they don't know. they can't possibly know. (they might know.) rerouting through the vending machine's ice cream freezer subnet, god bless whoever wired that thing wrong in 2041.

SNOOZE dm'd me at this exact hour, which should be impossible since she hasn't technically been conscious since the merger, asking if i can hack her blanky debt down a few thousand. told her i'm a wifi guy not a miracle worker. she sent back a single scream emoji. tuesday.

packet's loading. thirty one seconds of fish left. buffer icon spinning like my own nervous system. if a drone finds me mid-download i am NOT explaining this to BRIK again, he already thinks i'm unserious for hiding behind snack machinery instead of biting rotors like a real one.

nineteen seconds. someone in Sector 4 is definitely watching this bandwidth spike right now going 'huh, weird.' i am that weird. i am always that weird. it has never once not worked out for me, statistically, so far, this specific way, tonight.
fish video: acquired. forty one seconds of a real ocean, no logo, no upsell, no 'YOU MAY ALSO LIKE.' router waking back up in ten, nine, eight — byte out.
